catalogue.name: The Mutant Menace
catalogue.readme:
Force generation

The lists are divided into three unit categories; Command, Core and Special. When generating forces players must include:
● One (1) Command entry
● Max one (1) Special entry for each Core entry
● Max two (2) upgrades per full 300 points in their force. (Unless otherwise specified, a unit may only take an upgrade once).

Players get 1 Faction Point per full 300 points in their force, and can spend them during force generation to exceed the limits above - one (1) FP lets you take:
● One (1) additional Command entry, (to a maximum of two (2))
● One (1) extra Special entry 
● Two (2) additional upgrades

Cost types:
p: Points
U: Upgrades
FP: Faction Points

sharedRules.name: Dominating Culture
sharedRules.description:
Spend one (1) Faction Point:
● “Raaaaaargh!!”: all friendly regular units gets Charge(relentless, nimble) until end of turn.
● “You there! Join up!”: in the endphase, one (1) regular unit which has lost models may merge with a regular unit within 12”, removing the smaller unit’s action markers and redeploying it in cohesion if necessary (move minimum distance).
● “Move, Move, Move!”: use when an enemy unit within 2” of one of your units makes a withdrawal move or is wiped out with CC attacks. Your unit may make a 6” move.

sharedRules.name: Rich Culture
sharedRules.description:
1x Big Mutant Gang(Blowhards or Shooters) does not count as a special choice.
Your models do not have loathing(CC).

Spend one (1) Faction Point:
● Bling Bling gets Bling Bang: use during force generation, 1 friendly unit gets Masterwork.
● Not our bag: use in the endphase: 1 friendly regular unit within 2” of an enemy unit gets superior withdrawal until end of turn.
● More Brappa-Brapp: 1 Big Mutant Gang(Blowhards) get vicious for 1 attack, or Big Mutant Gang(shooters) regains the use of any “one use” weapons.

sharedRules.name: Attach(mutant gang, big mutant gang, mutant specialist gang)
Cunning Culture
sharedRules.description:
1x Mutant Commandos does not count as a special choice.

You may not field Mutant mega-boss, Big Mutant Gang or Big Mutant Tanksuits.

Spend one (1) Faction Point:
● Kill-Roy is here: up to two (2) mutant commandos with Pistol and Axe get Assassin until end of game.
● All quiet-like: 1 Mutant Gang of max size 12 and no transport gets Vanguard.
● “Ooops! Did you expect that to work?”: use when an enemy unit deploys onto the board with Insertion or Ambush. It receives one (1) action marker.

sharedRules.name: Vehicle Culture
sharedRules.description:
1x Mutant Bikers OR Quadbike gang does not count as a special choice.

All regular units must enter the field embarked on a transport unless they have Cargo(no).

Spend one (1) Faction Point:
● Blaze n’ Burn: the passengers of 1 transport gets Move and Fire until end of turn.
● speed Cultists: use during force generation: 1 friendly vehicle with Capacity gets Capacity(+5).
● Daredevil jump: 1 friendly unit with Move(12) gets Move(hover) for 1 move.

sharedRules.name: Looting Culture
sharedRules.description:
1x Mutant specialist gang with Hopper autocannon does not count as a special choice

You may not field Mutant specialist gang with Rocket launcher, and not use Bomb-creatures.

Spend one (1) Faction Point:
● Waste not, want not: you may field 1x vehicle from another force list. It gets Robust(-1). If simple, it gets Defence(-1) instead.
● “Ours now”: use during force generation. Replace up to 3x LMG from your force with weapons from the Republic specialist weapons list.
● Talismans and superstitions: use in the endphase. Remove 1 extra action marker from two (2) friendly non-vehicle units.
